title: Spyglass: Officially Launched!
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, making this powerful new tool fully available to all users with improved stability and an enhanced experience.

title: Total Control: Enhanced File Management and Display
summary: Take charge of your content with our latest update, offering intuitive tools to manage, upload, and customize the display of all your embedded files directly within the editor.

title: Introducing Our New Public Roadmap
summary: Easily track our progress and future plans with our new public roadmap, detailing what's shipped, what's next, and what's on the horizon.

title: Upgraded Checkboxes for Seamless Task Management
summary: Manage your tasks with greater ease using our newly upgraded checkboxes, featuring improved sizing, clickability, and seamless drag-and-drop functionality.

title: Next-Level Collaborative Editing
summary: Experience a smoother, more intuitive collaborative editing environment with enhanced real-time syncing and improved visibility into your team's contributions.

title: Enhanced Sharing
summary: We've made it easier than ever to discover and utilize content shared by your connections, boosting your collaborative potential.

title: Noeko: Now Open Source!
summary: Noeko is now fully open source, empowering our community with unprecedented control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in the project's future.

title: Global Language Support
summary: We're thrilled to introduce comprehensive international language support, enabling users worldwide to enjoy Noeko in their native tongue.

title: Elevate Your Experience: Theme Refresh & Expansion
summary: Get ready to personalize your workspace with beautifully refined existing themes and a vibrant collection of brand-new visual styles.

title: Personalized Constellation Discovery
summary: Discover hidden insights and streamline your workflow with powerful new filtering capabilities and social sharing visibility within your enhanced knowledge Constellation.

title: Advanced Search & Curated Collections
summary: Effortlessly narrow down your knowledge with robust filtering, powerful sorting options, and the ability to save your custom search views as personalized collections for quick access.

title: Dynamic Content Previews
summary: Streamline your thought process and enhance content discovery with dynamic previews of linked information directly within your notes.

title: Noeko: Take Control with Self-Hosting and Premium Plans
summary: We are excited to release Noeko with versatile self-hosting capabilities and premium plans, enabling teams and individuals to unlock enhanced features and greater flexibility.

title: Enhanced Time-Aware Greetings
summary: Our app will now greet you with the most accurate and delightful message, perfectly matching the time of day, enhancing your personalized experience.

title: Effortless Tag Management
summary: Efficiently organize your content by quickly removing items from a tag or deleting them directly within any tag view, saving you valuable time.

title: Expand Your Content Universe
summary: Empower your research and knowledge capture by effortlessly integrating diverse content types, such as YouTube videos, websites, and text files, directly into your workspace.
